text: **The exit is event-driven, not swept: there is no interval to configure and none is configured.** A polled implementation passes AC-01.1 with a long enough test and leaves a window proportional to the poll period, during which the orphan is still holding the store. Evidence is structural -- no timer, no periodic `getppid`, no sleep loop on the lifeline path -- because a timing assertion cannot distinguish a fast poll from an event.
